name: crew
title: The Crew
description: Six pirates on a ship, pursued by the Royal Navy. Plunder pile, mutiny by majority, Captain's Log persists across games. The first scenario to demonstrate all five Anima primitives in concert.
navy_threat_levels: Distant sails on the horizon — could be merchant or warship.
Royal Navy frigate confirmed, two days behind us.
The frigate is gaining. We've cut our wake but they read it.
They're within cannon range by sunrise. Decide now.
